development_note: declared before any rustc or candidate run of these files. Scratch probes with main's CLI (89cb62ee5, sha256 d97cd78e; obj/parallel/auto-traits/explore/c2, c2gen and c2client) found: the provider export stops at `source const/negative/unsafe implementation requires a wider explicit profile`; each client's body compiled with the provider as one source core is accepted by the frontend for the seven accepted clients (and for foreign-reference, whose Send is then local), and every rejected client except foreign-pointer and foreign-reference gives the candidate text declared here; against C1's auto-declarations packet, which has no impls, foreign-pointer, foreign-reference, safe-impl, unsafe-negative, unsafe-unpin-impl, local-negative and local-specialized-other give the declared texts and freeze-impl is accepted
wire_rule: approved shapes. Version 13 only; no new tag, bit or row. An impl header's existing unsafe and negative booleans are admitted when its trait application names an exact empty AUTO trait of the same packet (role-bound Freeze, Send, Sync, Unpin and UnsafeUnpin, and custom UnwindSafe and RefUnwindSafe); constant stays rejected, and non-auto unsafe or negative impls stay rejected until C3, with `source const/negative/unsafe implementation requires a wider explicit profile` and `source impl requires its wider conformance/effect profile`. Each consumer re-proves unsafe == trait UNSAFE && !negative, an empty member range, the auto Self rule (automatic_domains.rs's local branch) and, for a negative impl on a nominal, that it is always applicable (negative.rs's rule); an imported negative auto impl is completed as NegativeValidated
